name: PromptBase
tagline: PromptBase is a marketplace where creators buy and sell engineered prompts for ChatGPT, DALL-E, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, and other AI tools. Users browse prompts by category, preview sample outputs before purchasing, and download the full prompt after checkout. For sellers, it is a way to monetize prompt engineering work; for buyers, it provides a shortcut to results that would take significant trial and error to achieve independently.
